title: C2 Crank Cocking Aids for Excalibur Crossbows Recalled Due to Impact Injury and Laceration Hazards; Manufactured by Excalibur Crossbow
summary: The C2 Crank's cocking hooks can break during use, causing flying plastic hook projectiles, posing impact injury and laceration hazards to the user and bystanders. Units: About 15,000 (In addition, about 3,920 were sold in Canada).

title: Essential Medical Supply Reannounces Recall of Adult Portable Bed Rails Due to Entrapment and Asphyxia Hazards; Two Additional Deaths Reported After 2021 Recall
summary: When attached to an adult's bed, users can become entrapped within the bed rail or between the rail and the side of the mattress. This poses a serious entrapment hazard and risk of death by asphyxiation. Units: About 272,000.

title: Lovey & Grink Recalls Children's Pajamas Due to Burn Hazard; Violation of Federal Flammability Regulations for Children's Sleepwear
summary: The recalled children's pajamas violate the flammability regulations for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: About 23,720.

title: Thule Recalls RideAlong Rear-Mounted Child Bike Seats Due to Chemical Ingestion Hazard
summary: The harness padding of Thule RideAlong bike seats can contain flame-retardant DecaBDE in excess of regulatory limits, posing a chemical hazard. DecaBDE can be toxic if it is ingested or comes into contact with skin or eyes. Units: About 8,640 (In addition, about 3,880 were sold in Canada).

title: Two Million Black+Decker® Garment Steamers Recalled by Empower Brands in Major Recall Expansion Due to Burn Hazard; Refund Now Offered
summary: The steamers can expel, spray, or leak hot water during use, posing a burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 1.6 million (518,500 units were previously recalled in November 2022).

title: Walmart Recalls Mainstays Electric Mini Choppers Due to Laceration Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Walmart
summary: The chopper's blade can operate unexpectedly during assembly or when not enclosed in the container, posing a laceration hazard to consumers. Units: About 51,750.

title: Zazaba International Recalls Grão de Gente Baby Nests Due to Suffocation Risk and Fall and Entrapment Hazards; Violation of the Federal Safety Regulations; Sold Exclusively on Zazaba.com
summary: The recalled baby nests violate the safety requirements of CPSC's Safety Standard for Infant Sleep Products, posing a suffocation risk and fall and entrapment hazards to infants. title: Zazaba International Recalls Grão de Gente Crib Bumpers Due to Suffocation Hazard; Violation of Federal Crib Bumper Ban; Sold Exclusively on Zazaba.com
summary: Infants can suffocate if they roll or move on the crib bumper in a position that obstructs breathing. Padded crib bumpers are banned under the Safe Sleep for Babies Act of 2021. Units: About 795.

title: Full Speed Ahead Recalls Gossamer Pro AGX+ Cranksets Sold on Bicycles Due to Fall and Injury Hazards
summary: The bicycle's crank arms can loosen and/or detach from the crank/spindle, posing fall and injury hazards. Units: About 12,300 (In addition, about 250 were sold in Canada).

title: Gasaciods Children's Helmets Recalled Due to Risk of Head Injury; Violation of Federal Safety Regulation for Bicycle Helmets; Imported by Fengwang Sports; Sold Exclusively on Temu.com
summary: The helmets do not comply with the positional stability, dynamic strength of retention system, impact attenuation, and certification requirements in violation of the CPSC federal safety regulation for bicycle helmets. title: Randder Liquid Fuel Bottles Recalled Due to Risk of Burn and Poisoning; Violation of the Children's Gasoline Burn Prevention Act; Sold Exclusively on Amazon.com by Render Store
summary: The portable fuel containers do not meet the child-resistant requirements for closures under the Children's Gasoline Burn Prevention Act (CGBPA). The closure for the products is not child resistant, posing a risk of burns and poisoning to children. Units: About 1,830.

title: BRS Liquid Fuel Bottles Recalled Due to Risk of Poisoning and Burn Hazard; Violation of the Children's Gasoline Burn Prevention Act; Sold Exclusively on Amazon.com by Huenco
summary: The portable fuel bottles do not meet the child-resistant requirements for closures under the Children's Gasoline Burn Prevention Act (CGBPA). The closure for the products is not child-resistant, posing a risk of burn and poisoning to children. Units: About 1,600.

title: Delta Cycle Recalls Bicycle Stem Raisers Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The Stem Raiser can shift during use, causing the bicycle's handlebar to shift unexpectantly, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 500,000 (In addition, about 8,510 were sold in Canada).

title: Fischer Sports Recalls Junior Ski Boots Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The ski boot cuff can rotate, causing the lock mechanism to malfunction, posing a fall hazard and risk of injury to the consumer. Units: About 1,460 (In addition, about 114 were sold in Canada).

title: Innovative Bedding Solutions and SBL Recall GhostBed Natural Mattresses Due to Fire Hazard; Violation of Federal Mattress Flammability Regulation
summary: The mattresses violate the smoldering ignition requirements of the federal mattress flammability regulation, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 1,250.

title: Intimidator Recalls Intimidator and Mahindra Utility Vehicles (UTVs) Due to Crash Hazard
summary: The universal joint can fail and pierce and sever the brake line, posing a crash hazard. Units: About 19,264.

title: Johnson Health Tech North America Expands Recall of Matrix T1 and T3 Commercial Treadmills Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The power cord can become loose from the treadmill's power socket, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 9,700 (About 19,900 were previously recalled in January 2022).

title: Red Land Cotton Recalls Quilts and Shams Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: Pieces of broken needles were found inside some quilts and quilted shams, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 17,400.

title: Touchat Area Rugs Recalled Due to Fire Hazard; Violation of Federal Flammability Regulations; Sold Exclusively on Amazon.com by Touchat
summary: The recalled area rugs violate the mandatory federal flammability regulations for carpets and rugs, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 356.

title: Yoto Recalls Yoto Mini Speakers for Children Due to Burn and Fire Hazards
summary: The speaker's lithium-ion battery can overheat and catch fire, posing burn and fire hazards to consumers. Units: About 251,165 (In addition, about 18,932 were sold in Canada).

title: Zipline Kits Recalled Due to Fall Hazard; Sold Exclusively on Amazon.com by Jugader
summary: The zipline's stainless-steel cable can break, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 6,600.

title: 3M Recalls Peltor X4 Series Earmuffs Due to Risk of Overexposure to Loud Noise and Sound
summary: The recalled noise-reducing earmuffs can develop cracks in the colored portion of the plastic cups, posing a risk of overexposure to loud noise and sound. Units: About 40,000 (In addition, about 6,700 were sold in Canada).

title: Crate & Barrel Recalls Hampshire Cribs Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The recalled log splitter's hydraulic cylinder rod can separate from the piston, preventing the wedge from retracting. Reengaging the rod to the piston can cause the rod and wedge to move unexpectedly, posing injury hazards. Units: About 3,200 (In addition, about 120 were sold in Canada).

title: Crosman Recalls Icon Air Rifles Due to Injury Hazard
summary: An uncocked and loaded air rifle can discharge unexpectedly if jolted or dropped, posing an injury hazard. Units: About 2,500.

title: JAKKS Pacific Recalls Children's Mario Kart Ride-On Racer Car Toys Due to Crash Hazard
summary: If the acceleration pedal on the battery-operated ride-on toy becomes clogged with debris, it can stick after the user's foot is removed from the pedal, posing a crash hazard. Units: About 17,500.

title: Multi-Purpose Kids' Bike Helmets Recalled Due to Risk of Head Injury; Violation of Federal Safety Regulation for Bicycle Helmets; Sold Exclusively on Temu.com; Imported by Chau River Sports Outdoors
summary: The helmets do not comply with the dynamic strength of retention system, impact attenuation and certification requirements of the CPSC federal safety regulation for bicycle helmets. The helmets can fail to protect in the event of a crash, posing a risk of head injury. Units: About 200.

title: Oregon Tool Recalls Log Splitters and Cylinder Kits Due to Injury Hazards
summary: The recalled log splitter's hydraulic cylinder rod can separate from the piston, preventing the wedge from retracting. Reengaging the rod to the piston can cause the rod and wedge to move unexpectedly, posing injury hazards. Units: About 29,560 (In addition, about 4,690 were sold in Canada).

title: Sant and Abel Recalls Children's Pajamas Due to Burn Hazards
summary: The children's pajamas fail to meet the flammability standards for children's sleepwear, posing a burn hazard to children. Units: About 935.
